question: Convert 2.5 radians to degrees.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

We know the standard conversion where 1 radian is approximately equal to 57.3°.

To convert 2.5 radians to degrees, we simply multiply the value by 57.3°.

⇒ 2.5 × 57.3° = 143.25°

Looking at the given options, the closest exact value is 143.24°.

**∴ The correct answer is 143.24°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Angle = 2.5 radians

**Formula Used:**

Angle in Degrees = Angle in Radians × (180° ÷ π)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
• 
 
 
• 
 
 

 
 2.5 rad
 143.24°
 
 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Angle in Degrees = 2.5 × (180° ÷ π)

⇒ Angle in Degrees = 450° ÷ π

Using the precise value of π ≈ 3.14159:

⇒ Angle in Degrees = 450° ÷ 3.14159

⇒ Angle in Degrees ≈ 143.2395°

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 143.24°.

**∴ The correct answer is 143.24°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Radian to Degree Conversion

To convert any given angle from radians to degrees, multiply the radian value by 180° ÷ π.

Degree to Radian Conversion

To convert an angle from degrees back to radians, multiply the degree value by π ÷ 180°.

Standard Conversions

Some common unit circle angles include: π radians = 180°, π ÷ 2 radians = 90°, and π ÷ 4 radians = 45°.
